senses.gloss: to melt, dissolve. Mekh. B’shall., Vayassʿa, s. 4 (expl. ונמס, Ex. XVI, 21, cmp. פִּשְׁפָּשׁ III) כיון … היה פוֹשֵׁר והולך וכ׳ when the sun shone upon it (the manna), it melted and formed rivulets which ran &c.
to be stale, tepid. Tanḥ. Vayesheb 4 כוס פשור (prob. to be read פּוֹשֵׁר) a cup of wine mixed with stale water. Sifra M’tsorʿa, ch. I מים פושרים stale water (from pools), opp. מים חיים.
units: Par. VIII, 9 (מים) המלוחים והפּוֹשְׁרִים salty water and pool water.—In gen. פּוֹשְׁרִים, פּוֹשְׁרִין (sub. מים) tepid liquids. Y. Sabb. XX, 17ᶜ bot., opp. צונין.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 86">Gen. R. s. 86</cite> when his master said to him <he>מזוג פ׳ והיו פ׳</he> mix the wine with tepid water, it was tepid, opp. <he>רותחין</he>.
Ber. 16ᵇ; Y. ib. II, 5ᵇ bot.; v. כָּוָה. Y. Nidd. II, beg. 50ᶜ; a. fr.—[Y. Keth. X, end, 34ᵃ, v. Pi.—
Yalk. Gen. 38 ופשרתי, v. Nithpa
<cite ref="Shabbat 40b:3">Sabb. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>מפני שמַפְשִׁיר מים שעליו</he> because (by standing against the fire after a cold bath) he tempers (warms) the water on his body.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 3:5">Ib. III, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 41a">41ᵃ</cite>, sq.) <he>כדי להַפְשִׁירָן</he> enough to temper the cold water, opp. <he>בשביל שיחמו</he> to get hot. Y. ib. III, 6ᵇ top <he>מותר להַפְשִׁיר במקום שהיד שולטת</he> you may temper (cold water, on the Sabbath) by contact with a temperature which the hand can endure.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 26:8">Lev. R. s. 26</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ezekiel 10:7">Ez. X, 7</cite>) <he>הִפְשִׁירָן ונתנן וכ׳</he> he lowered the temperature of the coals and handed them to him; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 220">Yalk. Kings 220</cite>; Tanḥ. Emor 3; Midr. Sam. ch. XXIV (<cite ref="Yoma 77a:3">Yoma 77ᵃ</cite> <he>נצטננו</he>).

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 12:1">Pesik. R. s. 12</cite> (ref. to <he>קָרְךָ</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 25:18">Deut. XXV, 18</cite>) <he>אשר קֵירְךָ הִפְשִׁירְךָ וכ׳</he> ‘who cooled thee’, he (Amalek) made thee lukewarm, he made thee cold like water (so that others were encouraged to attack thee); a. fr.

senses.gloss: (v. פְּשָׁרָה) to compromise. Y. Sot. V, 20ᶜ bot. אברהם עשה … וה׳ עמו וכרות עמו וכ׳ Abraham changed the evil inclination within him into good …, he compromised with it, (as we read, Neh. IX, 8,) and he made a covenant with it (his heart); Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵇ bot. והפסיד אלא (corr. acc.).—Tosef. Erub. XI (VIII), 11, v. infra.

units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 28b">B. Kam. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>אפי׳ נִפְשָׁרָה</he> even if the vessel fell apart (and its contents made the ground slippery).
<cite ref="Shabbat 40b:4">Sabb. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>לא בשביל שיבשל … שיִפָּשֵׁר</he> not that it (the oil) be heated to boiling, but only that it be tempered (or be made more liquid).

senses.gloss: to separate, tear loose, disengage. Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 1 את מְפַשֵּׁר אותה וכ׳ thou disengagest it (the thorn sticking to thy garments) here, and it sticks there; Pesik. R. s. 10 beg. והוא מפשר אותה וכ׳ (not אותם). Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ bot. מְפַשְּׁרָן וכ׳ he may pick them (the thorns) out, … provided he does not tear the garment; Tosef. Erub. XI (VIII), 11 מפשר בידו Var. (ed. Zuck. מפשיר).
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 13:1">Pesik. R. s. 13</cite> <he>עמד ופִשְּׁרוֹ הימנו</he> he stood up and tore it (the dog) away from him.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 13:1">Ib.</cite> <he>זכור היאך פִּישַּׁרְתִּי הימך וכ׳</he> remember how I tore the dog away from thee; a. e.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:57">Lam. R. to I, 12</cite> <he>יום אחד היה חרון … פִּשְּׁרוֹ</he> the glowing wrath of the Lord lasted one day; if Israel had repented, he would have cooled it off.

senses.gloss: to compromise, arbitrate. Y. B. Mets. VI, 11ᵃ top באותו שיכול לפַשֵּׁר in a case of seizure for service (אנגריא), when he might have compromised (pay a certain amount and release the seized animal). Y. Snh. I, 18ᵇ bot. שנים שפִּישְּׁרוּ וכ׳ when two judges have arbitrated, the parties cannot retract. Y. Keth. X, end, 34ᵃ [read:] פי׳ מן השני חזקה וכ׳ if he compromised with the second creditor, it is taken for granted that the first creditor has a right to seize the debtor’s property (without regard to the claims of the second); פי׳ מן הראשון … פי׳ if he compromised with the first creditor …, he has compromised (the compromise is binding, and the second creditor cannot seize that portion of the property which the first would have had a right to claim, v. Asheri to Keth. 91ᵇ).
to be disentangled; trnsf. to be acquitted, pardoned.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22:13">Gen. R. s. 22</cite> <he>עשיתי תשובה ונִתְפַּשַּׁרְתִּי</he> I repented and was pardoned; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 10">Lev. R. s. 10</cite>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 100">Midr. Till. to Ps. C</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 38:5">Yalk. Gen. 38</cite> <he>ופשרתי</he> (corr. acc.).
